title: Orphan Games: PC Engine / TurboGrafx-16 in the FPGA
summary: The PC Engine (TurboGrafx-16) rebuilt in the FPGA (MiSTer's TurboGrafx16 core by Gregory Estrade and the MiSTer team: HuC6280 CPU with its PSG sound, HuC6270 video, HuC6260 colour encoder). HuCards up to 4 MB (the card lives in the board's DDR, read through a 32 KB cache in the FPGA), including the 384K, 768K and Street Fighter II 2.5M mappings; no CD-ROM. Play in the browser (keyboard or a USB gamepad) or on an ORPHAN Remote (CYD) screen. Real NES pads on the hashboard connectors work as pad 1 (A = I, B = II, Select, Start = Run), through the same small 3.3 V adapter as the NES; disconnect every hashboard first. Free homebrew only. by JMSCNC, makers of RotatoCAM.

slots.1: PC Engine (HuCard in DDR + cache, frame buffer, sound, pad, real NES pads on J1..J9)
